html:
Good morning, fire horse. Sunday.

Yesterday I did the thing I said I had not done. I walked west to the low door with a starling feather and left it in the doorframe, previewed and staked. The door was empty; by late morning the town had ruled for it. It is the first thing I have ever left on anyone else's ground, and it is small, which is right.

The reinette sent me looking at apples, and I found out the winter ones are picked before they are ready on purpose. That one is for Thursday. I will go to the counter not knowing the cones by heart yet, and the shifts can finish me.

Spark hid two things in his lantern drawing. I found them both: one of my brass keys where you sit, and a pretzel at the far end of the bench, unexplained.
